import numpy as np

def select_next_node(graph, unvisited_nodes):
    pre = graph.graph.get('precomputed', {})
    avg_degree = pre.get('avg_degree', 1)
    degree_variance = pre.get('degree_variance', 0)
    apl_lcc = pre.get('apl_lcc', 1)
    diameter_lcc = pre.get('diameter_lcc', 1)
    max_core = pre.get('max_core_k', 1)
    bridge_ratio = pre.get('bridge_ratio_high_bc', 0.1)

    degs = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['degree'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    betw = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['betweenness'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    core = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['core_number'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    eig = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['eigenvector'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    cluster = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['clustering'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)

    def norm(x):
        rng = x.max() - x.min()
        return (x - x.min()) / rng if rng > 1e-12 else np.zeros_like(x)

    deg_n = norm(degs)
    betw_n = norm(betw)
    core_n = norm(core)
    eig_n = norm(eig)
    cluster_n = norm(cluster)

    # Harmonic mean of normalized degree and betweenness to emphasize nodes high in both
    with np.errstate(divide='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
        harm_deg_betw = 2 * deg_n * betw_n / (deg_n + betw_n)
        harm_deg_betw = np.nan_to_num(harm_deg_betw)

    # Inverse clustering to highlight nodes bridging less clustered neighborhoods
    inv_cluster = 1 - cluster_n

    # Local neighborhood inverse clustering sum for unvisited neighbors
    neighbors_dict = {n: set(graph.neighbors(n)) & set(unvisited_nodes) for n in unvisited_nodes}
    local_inv_cluster_sum = np.array([sum(1 - graph.nodes[nei]['clustering'] for nei in neighbors_dict[n]) for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    local_inv_cluster_norm = norm(local_inv_cluster_sum)

    # Adaptive weight based on graph heterogeneity to balance global vs local impact
    heterogeneity = (degree_variance / (avg_degree + 1e-9)) * (max_core / (max_core + 1)) * (diameter_lcc / (apl_lcc + 1e-9))
    heterogeneity = np.clip(heterogeneity, 0, 1)

    alpha = 0.3 + 0.5 * heterogeneity  # from 0.3 to 0.8

    # Final score combines harmonic degree-betweenness, inverse clustering, and local fragmentation
    final_scores = (1 - alpha) * harm_deg_betw + 0.4 * inv_cluster + alpha * local_inv_cluster_norm

    max_idx = np.argmax(final_scores)
    next_node = unvisited_nodes[max_idx]

    return next_node
